answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 7 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the bridge count is verified against the tide text itself, the wander audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 194 aliases thus means producing 194 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 30 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
